_description: CCNL lavoro domestico, convivente level CS (Tabella A), March 2026 regular run, permanent, 54 weekly hours.
_notes: Tabella A, livello CS, valori mensili decorrenti dal 01/01/2026: 1.193,84.
Board and lodging are provided in kind (art. 36; Tabella F 2,33 + 2,33 + 2,00 per day, x 30 = 199,80): not paid in cash on a regular run, so no fixed allowance is paid.
Hours: 54 weekly hours (art. 14 c. 1 lett. a), 216 contributable hours (54 x 4 weeks), the hours the published Workledger payslip of the same case declares.
